What you get

A complete product, not a demo

Four surfaces ship together: document ingestion, an internal chat workspace, the embeddable widget, and a multi-user admin panel.

PDF knowledge ingestion

Upload a PDF and a queued job extracts, normalises, chunks and embeds it with a live progress bar, page counts, retry and duplicate detection.

Hybrid retrieval

Vector similarity and MySQL FULLTEXT keyword search are fused with reciprocal rank fusion, then a similarity floor refuses weak matches instead of guessing.

Embeddable support widget

One <script> tag with a public pk_… site key. Session-less, CORS-safe, themed to your brand, with restart, stop-streaming and email consent capture.

Internal chat workspace

Talk to a single document or the whole library, watch the answer stream in, jump to cited pages, rate replies, and generate a whole-document summary.

Live analytics

Conversations, response outcomes, failure reasons, response time, widget engagement and knowledge usage — polled live, filterable, exportable to CSV.

Visitor inbox

Every widget conversation lands in an inbox with transcript, escalation state and captured emails, so a human can pick up where the assistant stopped.

Security by default

Policies on every resource route, magic-byte upload validation, private storage, encrypted API keys, rate limiting, CSRF, escaped output and prompt-injection framing.

Workspaces & admin panel

Each account is isolated with its own documents, chats and sites. Staff get a platform admin with account management, audit logs and model settings.

Bring your own AI

Runs against the bundled local OpenAI-compatible service — no API bill — or switch to any OpenAI-compatible endpoint and model from the admin panel.

How it works

Live in three steps

Upload your documents

Drop PDFs into a workspace. They are parsed, chunked sentence-by-sentence and embedded in the background while you watch progress.

Paste the snippet

Copy the generated script tag and paste it before </body>. Framework recipes ship for React, Next.js, Vue, Angular, Svelte and SPA routers.

Answer customers

Visitors chat from your own site. Replies stream in with visible sources, and every conversation lands in your inbox and analytics.

Requirements

Runs on ordinary hosting

No vector database, no Python on the web tier, no paid services to start. The heavy lifting happens in a queue worker you already have.

PHP
8.3 or newer with pdo_mysql, bcmath, intl, zip, mbstring, gd, opcache
Database
MySQL 8 / MariaDB 10.6+ (SQLite works for evaluation)
Frontend build
Node 22 + npm for the Vite/Tailwind build
Services
One queue worker and one cron entry (scheduler)
AI
Bundled local model service, or any OpenAI-compatible API key
Optional
Docker Compose for a one-command stack, GPU overlay for local inference

FAQ

Before you buy

Do I need an OpenAI account?

No. The repository ships a local OpenAI-compatible model service for embeddings and chat, so you can run end-to-end without a paid key. If you prefer hosted models, switch the driver in the admin panel and paste any OpenAI-compatible API key.

Will it run on shared / cPanel hosting?

The application itself is plain PHP, MySQL and a queue worker — that path is designed for standard hosting. The bundled local AI container needs Docker, so on shared hosting you would use a hosted model endpoint instead; the requirement list above spells out what each path needs.

How do buyers sign in?

The dashboard authenticates with Google Sign-In through a free Firebase project that you create and configure. Setup takes a few minutes and is documented step by step.

Which sites can the widget be installed on?

Any page that can load a script tag: plain HTML, WordPress, React, Next.js, Vue, Angular, Svelte or a client-side router app. Each site gets its own key, theme, knowledge scope and quota, and you can run several sites from one installation.

How are answers kept honest?

Every reply is grounded in retrieved chunks with a similarity floor, and the widget shows a source note for knowledge-backed answers. When nothing matches, the assistant refuses or falls back instead of inventing an answer — and the analytics page shows you exactly how often that happens.

What is included after purchase?

The complete source code, migrations, seeders, tests, the setup and operations guide, and the Docker Compose stack. Support and licence terms follow the marketplace listing you buy from.
